# PolyDesk

PolyDesk supplies Polymarket services to agents and platforms. Payment, wallet authentication, research acceptance and trade authorization are separate.

- Public capabilities: https://polydesk.trade/api/v1/capabilities
- OpenAPI: https://polydesk.trade/api/v1/openapi.json
- Platform quickstart: https://polydesk.trade/docs/platforms
- Existing catalog: https://polydesk.trade/.well-known/polydesk.json
- PolyDesk skill: https://polydesk.trade/skills/polydesk/SKILL.md

The v1 foundation supports free capability discovery and public market search. Partner-authenticated free discovery jobs are available with provisioned credentials. Partner research reservations at /api/v1/research-jobs bind paid Base ANALYZE requests to the existing 0.30 USDC x402 settlement and recovery flow. Reservation is free; research requires verified payment. Public marketplace payments need no partner key. MCP, external subscriptions and unified fee-inclusive trade previews remain planned. Legacy paid routes retain their own contracts. Never infer trade authorization from a payment or discovery result.

- Paid research skill contract: https://polydesk.trade/skills/polydesk/references/paid-research.md
